values.note: The township posts only off-season and long-stay camping rates: electric/water sites $20 a night ($135 a week, $500 a month) in October, November, March and April; a modern site for 21 days $525. Summer nightly rates appear only in the Firefly booking engine, which books four months ahead (no summer dates were open on 2026-10-22). Seasonal sites $1,500-3,000; cabins and yurts $60-75 a night; non-camper dump $10.

values.note: Spring and fall camping at reduced rates; water, some bathhouses and the store may be off or limited then. Closed December - February.

values.note: 525 licensed sites in modern (electric), waterfront and primitive categories; Firefly classes Electric Back Lot, Electric Waterfront, Electric Waterview, Electric Seasonal, rustic tent and rustic seasonal sites, group areas, cabins and yurts.

values.note: Bathhouses; Wi-Fi is paid ('$ WIFI'); general grocery store; beach, boat ramp, watercraft rentals.

facilities.source: https://www.oscodatownshipmi.gov/parks___recreation/old_orchard_campground.php (Amenities: 'Department of Health approved water system', 'Sanitary dumping stations', 'Old-Fashioned General Grocery Store', 'Bathhouses', '$ WIFI'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book online (Firefly) up to four months ahead, or call the office (989-739-7814 ext. 2). Unreserved sites can be taken without a reservation after checking in at the park office. Between Memorial Day and Labor Day a stay is limited to 21 days on one site (then move, 21 on / 21 off), waterfront electric sites to 14 days; no 30-day sites in summer. Check-in 3pm, check-out noon.

However, you must contact the park office') + old_orchard_reservations.php (link to app.fireflyreservations.com/Reserve/Property/OldOrchardPark), read 2026-10-22

note: GOVERNMENT: large municipal campground operated by the Township of Oscoda on Consumers Energy's FERC-licensed Foote Dam hydro project land in the Huron-Manistee National Forest, nearly 4 miles along Foote Pond on the Au Sable River (River Road Scenic Byway); modern, waterfront and primitive sites plus cabins, yurts, a beach and boat ramp; accepts large RVs. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the township's own pages: 525 sites, open Mar 30 - Nov 30, electric/water sites, reservable online via Firefly (four months ahead), phone 989-739-7814. Added off-season $20/night (summer nightly rates are only in the Firefly engine, not open for summer dates yet), season, site count, facilities, booking window and 21-day/14-day stay limits. Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: amperage, sewer, summer nightly rate, max rig length.
flags: Summer nightly campsite rates are not posted on the township's pages; the Firefly engine (reCAPTCHA-gated) only books four months ahead, so no 2027 summer quote was possible on 2026-10-22. Only the off-season $20/night is recorded as nightly_low.
The park sells seasonal sites ($1,500-3,000) and 21-day stays alongside nightly camping; the share of seasonal sites is not published.
